description.Reaver:
Reavers walk the outer edge of order.
Untamed in spirit yet loyal in blood, they strike hard and vanish faster, carrying the raw force of the Clan into hostile ground.
description.Templar:
Templars bind arcane discipline to martial precision.
Neither priest nor knight alone, they are the Clan’s sacred edge in times of war.
description.Shadow:
Shadows move where banners cannot.
Silent, deliberate, and unseen, they protect the Clan through knowledge and decisive action.
description.Vanguard:
The Vanguard hold the line where others would falter.
Shield-bound and oath-driven, they are the visible strength of the Clan and the first to answer any threat.
description.Seer:
Seers see beyond steel and shadow.
Guardians of ritual and foresight, they shape fate before blades are ever drawn.
description.Sentinel:
Sentinels stand where passage must be earned.
Watchful and steadfast, they guard the Clan’s gates, roads, and strongholds, meeting every threat before it can advance.

description2.Reaver:
Reavers are the Clan’s force of impact.
They operate beyond fortified lines, applying decisive violence where resistance must be broken.
description2.Templar:
Templars unite sanctioned arcana with martial discipline.
They serve as the consecrated blade of the Clan, enforcing doctrine through steel and ritual alike.
description2.Shadow:
Shadows execute operations unseen and unrecorded.
Their presence is measured not in banners raised, but in threats removed before they surface.
description2.Vanguard:
The Vanguard form the defensive core of the Clan.
Shield-bearing and oath-bound, they establish the line from which no ground is surrendered.
description2.Seer:
Seers maintain the Clan’s arcane authority.
Through foresight, ritual, and interpretation, they shape outcomes long before conflict begins.
